# V6 — Scope & Known Limitations (auto-generated)

> Generated by `scripts/v6/generate_scope_statements.py` from `model_v6_benchmark.json` + the audit verdicts — do NOT hand-edit. Re-running yields a byte-identical file.

## Headline

Shipped salinity anchor = **M0 (univariate NDMI logit)**, LOO AUC 0.682 (CI [0.556, 0.802]). **Regional calibration drift (W1):** pooled spatial AUC 0.385 vs per-block 0.792 — the model ranks salinity *locally* but absolute level must be calibrated per region.

## W1 — Regional calibration drift (FIRST-CLASS scope statement)

- Pooled spatial leave-block-out AUC: **0.385**.
- Mean per-block spatial AUC: **0.792**.
- The large pooled<per-block gap means between-region base-rate differences dominate the pooled metric. Cross-region suitability *ranking* is unreliable; within-region ranking is sound. This is a calibration-scope limitation, not loss of signal.

## W4/W5 — In-AOI vs out-of-AOI skill (do not conflate training with test)

- The seabed AOI is defined by the 1960 Aral footprint polygon (NOT the all-True `in_aoi` column).
- In-AOI (seabed) pits: **23**; out-of-AOI (wider Priaralye, training domain): **47**.
- Baseline in-AOI LOO AUC: **0.632**; out-of-AOI LOO AUC: **0.619**.
- The 47 out-of-AOI pits are TRAINING data for the mapped seabed target and must NOT be counted as independent validation. In-AOI skill is the honest test metric (small n — directional).

## Multi-predictor candidates tested & rejected (answers 'one predictor is too simple')

A recurring reviewer concern is that a single-predictor (NDMI) model looks too simple. The benchmark tests this directly and rejects the multi-predictor alternatives on the metric that matters for the product — skill on the mapped seabed, not pooled cross-region AUC.

- **Wall-to-wall RS-index pairs (the only ones that could ship as a map):** M4 (NDMI+NDWI) LOO AUC 0.786, M5 (NDMI+MSAVI) LOO AUC 0.796 — both beat M0's 0.682 on naive LOO, but per-block spatial AUC drops to 0.699/0.699 (vs M0 0.792). The lift is a between-region base-rate proxy (seabed vs. wider Priaralye) that the AOI mask already encodes; on the seabed it is not resolvable (only 4 non-saline in-AOI pits).
- **Region dummy (M3)** makes the base-rate mechanism explicit: inside the seabed the in-AOI flag is constant, so its in-AOI AUC collapses to 0.237 (below M0's 0.632) while pooled AUC balloons to 0.723.
- **Soil-lab predictors (M1/M2, sand/clay/Cl⁻)** raise LOO further but are POINT-ONLY — no wall-to-wall 30 m raster exists, so a two-predictor map cannot be built from them.
- **Decision:** the recommendation engine rejects all of M1–M5 by the per-block + in-AOI gates and keeps **M0** (cascade_needed=false). The single NDMI predictor is the only skill defensible on the mapped seabed at n=70. A genuine second predictor requires more non-saline in-seabed ground truth (a field campaign), not another index from the same imagery. See `model_v6_benchmark_report.md`.

## W10 — Temporal drift / calibration vintage

- Soil labels are 2012-2014 lab profiles (Pachikin/Kozybaeva); the NDMI composite is recent. The NDMI<->salinity relation is assumed quasi-stationary. No contemporaneous re-sampling exists to verify stationarity — treat the map as a screening aid, re-validate if recent ground truth appears.

## W11 — Sensor-coverage gaps (COVERAGE_FEASIBILITY.md verdict)

- 30 m SCL water mask: feasible only with GEE reprocessing (owner action) — not in-repo today.
- 30 m slope/TWI: only ~33% finite at 30 m; full restoration unlikely in-repo (no slope gate at 30 m).
- These gaps are why V6 lives on the 30 m stack as a salinity screen, not a full physical zoning.

## W12 — 10 m cascade re-evaluation trigger

- Re-test the 10 m cascade when valid-pixel n >= **30** (COVERAGE_FEASIBILITY.md Q3). Below that, the 10 m path is too sparse to evaluate honestly.

## 2020/2021 out-of-period data (VALIDATION_2020_2021_FEASIBILITY.md verdict)

- DECISION: the 2020/2021 campaign **cannot** be wired into the V6 pipeline now (pit IDs do not align across files; distinct ID schemes). It has modest value only as a **conservative out-of-period check** with strict period separation. It is **NOT merged** into the 2012-2014 training labels.

## Anti-patterns held (must not regress)

- suitability = 1 - P(saline); the exploratory NDMI+MSAVI->saxaul classifier is NOT a decision model.
- Salinity model independent of saxaul labels (no circularity).
- Every AUC carries a held-out bootstrap CI; raw AUC + direction reported.
